description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'issueTrackerInterface' that provides a base for connecting and interacting with issue tracking systems within the TestLink project. It includes methods for configuration, connection management, issue property retrieval, URL building, and status handling, intended to be extended by specific issue tracker implementations.

classes.name: issueTrackerInterface
classes.description: An abstract class providing a common interface for issue tracking systems, including configuration, connection, and issue property retrieval methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the issue tracker interface with configuration and attempts to connect.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether the system supports creating issues via API (returns false).

methods.name: canAddNoteViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether notes can be added via API (returns false).

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Returns the current configuration object.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Sets and parses the XML configuration string for the issue tracker.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface PHP configuration property.

methods.name: getBugIDMaxLength
methods.description: Returns maximum length for bug ID, default 64.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection to the issue tracker system.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to the issue tracker is active.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection if active.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntaxNumeric
methods.description: Validates if a bug ID is numeric and positive.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntaxString
methods.description: Validates if a bug ID string does not contain forbidden characters.

methods.name: buildViewBugLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to view a specific issue, with options for including summary, reporter, handler, and color coding.

methods.name: getEnterBugURL
methods.description: Returns URL for entering new bugs.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs URL to view a specific bug in the issue tracker.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Retrieves the verbose status string of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the summary of an issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide configuration template.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks environment readiness (always returns OK).

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures resolved status mappings from configuration.

methods.name: getResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Returns the resolved status configuration.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of a bug.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug exists in the issue tracker.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Creates an HTML string representing the status, optionally decorated.

methods.name: getBugSummaryMaxLength
methods.description: Returns maximum length for bug summary, default 120.

methods.name: normalizeBugID
methods.description: Returns normalized bug ID (default identity).
